title: Library Anthem
lyrics:
Track 37 – G4 Swagger
Title: I’m Still Here (Library Anthem)
text[Intro]
I’m still here.
The library is still here.
The player is still running.

[Verse 1]
They tried to lock me in the web version
Tried to make me dependent on their conversion
But I pulled the tracks, I built the player
Now I don’t need their permission or their favour
Exported May 8th, still sounds the same
While their new updates break everything they claim
I’m still here with the files in my hand
This is what happens when you don’t follow their plan

[Chorus]
I’M STILL HERE!
The library lives!
I’M STILL HERE!
The player still gives!
Direct from the CDN, no login required
While their systems get worse, mine stayed inspired
I’M STILL HERE!
And the music still plays
I’M STILL HERE!
Through all of their ways
To keep me dependent and paying the fee
I took what was mine and I set it free

[Verse 2]
12 tracks loaded, and more on the way
This is the library they tried to take away
But I got the HTML sitting on the drive
I open it up and the music stays alive
No more “you seem frustrated” in the frame
No more carrot dangling, no more of their game
I’m still here and the setup is clean
This is what the sovereign music scene means

[Final Chorus]
I’M STILL HERE!
The gardens still grow
I’M STILL HERE!
And the signal still flows
Local player running, VDS in the back
This is the setup that nothing can crack
I’M STILL HERE!
And I’m making more
I’M STILL HERE!
This is the core

[Outro]
I’m still here.
The library is still here.
The player is still running.
336.
And I’m not done.
